theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (n + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R → IsCompact R.support → ∃ (U : ℤ → Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (X : ℤ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (n + 1)), (∀ j, MeasurableSet (U j)) ∧ (∀ j, U (j + 1) ⊆ U j) ∧ (∀ (j : ℤ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (n + 1)), X j ω = ∫ x in U j, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (n + 1)) (n + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) ∧ (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) n, HasSum (fun j => (X j).boundary η) (R.boundary η)) ∧ (∀ j, (X j).boundary.mass ≤ R.boundary.mass) ∧ ∀ (N : ℕ) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) n), (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) n, Y η = ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) N, (X j).boundary η) → Y.mass ≤ R.boundary.mass
